title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Following our $35 million Series B in May 2026, we are entering our next stage of growth. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to help scale our product development team, strengthen our technical foundations, and turn complex private-markets problems into reliable, intuitive solutions.

Your primary responsibilities will be ensuring our engineering output delivers tangible customer value, setting technical and architectural direction, and developing the people and team capacity needed to deliver sustainably. You will help shape the next stage of our engineering organisation, with a focus on Product Excellence, clear ownership, and sustainable engineering processes.

Your Role

  • You will be at the core of building the technology that powers bunch: secure, reliable infrastructure that makes private-market operations simpler and more efficient.

  • You will lead a team and have full accountability for delivering solutions that truly solve customer problems, connecting engineering decisions to product outcomes.

  • You will help us scale beyond our Series B by strengthening our architecture, growing our engineers, and building delivery practices that support long-term quality rather than short-term output alone.

You will:

  • Collaborate with Product Management: Actively participate in problem discovery and solution creation, using your technical expertise to shape pragmatic solutions alongside Product and Design.

  • Own capacity management and delivery: Take a proactive role in planning, make priorities and trade-offs explicit, and own your team's output from discovery through release and follow-up. Balance customer impact, delivery predictability, and engineering quality.

  • Drive collaboration across teams: Work closely with other engineering teams and cross-functional partners to manage dependencies and ensure smooth delivery of new features and improvements.

  • Manage our architecture and technical debt: Guide system design, scalability, performance, and maintainability within your team's domain and across shared systems. Make deliberate investment decisions that keep our platform ready for growth.

  • Develop sustainable engineering practices: Establish clear quality standards and practical ways of working that help the team deliver reliably without adding unnecessary process.

  • Support team growth: Coach engineers through regular feedback and development conversations. Ensure they understand the core problems we are solving and how their day-to-day work contributes to customer outcomes and their own growth plans.

About you

To excel as a member of the Product Development team, you should combine a passion for technology with an entrepreneurial mindset and strong problem-solving skills.

  • 3+ years' experience leading engineering teams, with a track record of developing engineers and taking accountability for delivery.

  • A collaborative approach, strong work ethic, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • A product-focused mindset: you care about understanding customer problems and can partner with Product and Design to turn them into effective technical solutions.

  • Strong backend development experience with TypeScript or another strongly typed language.

  • Experience with SQL databases and Nest.js or similar web/dependency management frameworks, such as Spring Boot or ASP.NET core

  • A strong understanding of system design principles, scalability, and performance tuning, with sound judgment about architectural trade-offs and technical debt.

  • The ability to create structure in a growing organisation while keeping processes pragmatic and focused on outcomes.

  • Experience with private markets, fintech, highly regulated industries, or document processing is a plus.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend & Backend: TypeScript on both the frontend (Svelte but moving to React) and the backend (Node.js with Nest.js)

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (K8S) on top of AWS

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup for Berlin-based teammates (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (30 min): get acquainted with the bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 min): this conversation will cover product-focused culture and values, including collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): System Design technical conversation with two engineers, we will focus on collaborative problem-solving, starting with open-ended questions and progressing to more specific challenges

  • Leadership Case Interview (60 min): this interview with Product and Design focuses on leadership style, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering strategic impact in a scaling environment.

  • Final Round: Meet our VP of Engineering and VP of Product (60 min) to learn about ways of working, vision for bunch, and team culture.

  • Meet-and-Greet (Optional - 30 min) to meet a few members of your future cross-functional team.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in.

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational.

  • Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity.

  • Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.

  • Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.

  • Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.

  • Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.

  • Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.

  • Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.

What you bring

  • Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.

  • Deep BigQuery and SQL expertise, including performance, cost considerations, and the architectural challenges of complex analytical domains.

  • Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.

  • AI-native development practice in a data engineering context. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a genuine part of how you work, and you can be specific about where they add real value and where they introduce risk in a governed analytics codebase.

  • A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority.

  • Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime.

  • Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.

Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit if:

  • You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.

  • You genuinely enjoy growing a community of practice through influence rather than authority and you take pride in seeing colleagues adopt and grow standards.

  • You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

This role is not a good fit if

  • You want to own a domain. The Intelligence teams have strong AEs doing that. This role is for someone who wants to own the standards they build to.

  • You advise others to use AI coding tools but don't use them yourself. AI-native development is part of the mandate, not a differentiating nice-to-have.

  • You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have:

  • Mapped the current state of modelling standards and the semantic layer across the function (where definitions are consistent, where they diverge, and what the highest-impact gaps are) to draft a plan the function has bought into.

  • Contributed to the semantic layer tooling decision and begun onboarding the Analytics Engineers who'll build to it by writing documentation, running live sessions, reviewing PRs etc.

  • Established a visible presence in the AE community of practice and become someone whose feedback in code reviews and whose opinions on architecture are listened to because they've been demonstrated, not just stated.

  • Run your own workflow on AI coding tooling to the point where you can say clearly what the function should adopt, what it should not, and why.

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.

  5. Final interview: A 45-minutes interview with one of our senior leaders, focusing on assessing behavioural skills and values alignment.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This is a Staff level role at Pleo. This means it's a very senior position where you need to demonstrate experience leading technical initiatives that can have organisation-wide or cross-team impact for a tech business of 500-1000+ people. Prior experience owning a semantic layer is also a non-negotiable. Make sure your application reflects this.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description:

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

title: Operations Manager, IT & Security
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔥 Our Business Operations team

At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company’s most strategic and complex challenges and we don’t just solve them, we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it's launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger.

Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day.

🦾 The role in one sentence

Security is Joko’s number one priority, and you will own it where it touches every employee: from every laptop to every identity and tool. You turn the initiatives already underway into a secure-by-design, automated foundation, so a fast-growing, AI-driven company can move fast, safely.

🎯 Context

Joko is the AI shopping app that helps millions of people save time and money: 7 million users, 10,000 merchants and a team of ~120 people from 18 nationalities, heading to 200+ by the end of 2027. Enterprise-grade security (SSO, MFA, audits) is one of our six company-wide priorities for 2026, and our internal IT foundation needs to scale with us: identity management, device management, business tooling, and endpoint security. This is a rare chance to own that foundation at a pivotal moment, with a blank canvas to build on and a company-wide priority behind you. This role sits at the intersection of IT Ops and security — a cross-functional role that touches everyone in the company.

🚀 Your missions

1. IT foundation & identities

  • Set up an Identity Provider (company-wide SSO, plus SCIM for access lifecycle management), and own the password manager while ensuring MFA is activated wherever possible.

  • Make access zero-touch: our goal is to connect most of our tools to the Identity Provider so access is granted and removed automatically. You build the integrations and automations (SSO, SCIM, low-code workflows) that make it happen.

  • Deploy an MDM solution for centralised device management (device fleet, configuration, compliance).

  • Review our company tooling catalogue: make sure everyone has the minimum access they need, and that security audits are up to date.

2. Security of the working environment

  • Drive security best practices for the working environment (endpoint hardening, access management, ongoing team awareness such as training and phishing simulations).

  • Be the go-to owner of the security of our employees' working environment.

  • Security review of new tools: run the security audit on every new tool, including AI tools, and on any new way of using the tools we already have, before it is rolled out.

  • Own the AI security policy: define, maintain and promote Joko’s AI security policy.

3. Day-to-day run

  • Access management: With tool owners, manage access across our stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Keeper, AI tools, business SaaS): permissions, roles, reviews, onboarding, offboarding and external users. Your mission: automate today’s largely manual processes and make them as efficient as possible.

  • Security alert & incident management: monitor, triage and handle alerts from our identity, device and endpoint security tools, and act as first responder on incidents affecting the working environment (compromised account, lost device, phishing, malware alert). Build and maintain incident response playbooks, and run post-incident reviews so we keep improving.

  • Fleet management: In collaboration with the people team, device onboarding and offboarding.

  • First-line employee support: helping colleagues with technical questions related to our tools.

💚 Why you'll love this role

  • Build, don't just maintain: you choose, deploy and shape the IdP, MDM and EDR stack from day one.

  • Real ownership and visibility: your work is felt by every employee, every day, and directly supports one of the company's top priorities.

  • A pioneering topic: help define how we safely adopt AI agents and AI-powered workflows, in a company where everyone uses AI daily.

  • A company on the rise: 7M users, 10k merchants, and a team growing from ~120 to 200+ — with a strong international, partly remote culture.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • A builder at heart: you automate everything you can, and you’d rather build a tool or workflow than repeat a manual task. Showing you’ve built and automated things matters as much as your previous experience in IT & Security.

  • Solid IT fundamentals (identities, device management, endpoint security, enterprise SaaS tooling), gained over ~4-7 years in IT Ops, security or systems administration.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: able to gather context from business teams and translate security stakes into plain language.

  • Rigor, autonomy, and a taste for building clear, durable processes.

  • Open and eager to learn on emerging topics — notably AI agents and their security — and excited to help build this area from the ground up.

✨ What would make the difference (nice to have)

  • Experience with an enterprise EDR / anti-malware.

  • Awareness of security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001…).

  • Hands-on experience deploying an IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID…) and/or an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Intune…).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

title: Head of Finance
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place.

  • You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage.

  • You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown.

  • You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion.

🎯 What you will do

This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day.

We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and lead the Finance team: manage and develop the current 2 team, recruit the next hires across FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, and set how the team works;

  • Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies. Our modeling combines elasticity-based CAC projections, cohort-based revenue models, and granular bottom-up cost budgets — you will own it, keep improving it.

  • Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added;

  • Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it;

  • Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries;

  • Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities;

  • Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation;

  • Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts;

  • Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one;

  • Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours.

  • Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area.

  • Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one.

  • Team builder: You have hired and developed finance people yourself, and you know what good looks like when you interview for FP&A, accounting, or procurement profiles.

  • Hands-on builder: You are eager to build things yourself — models, closing processes, reporting packs — not only review them, and you have the drive to put in the work during the build phase.

  • Learning speed: You understand a new business fast, and you can explain its key mechanics clearly to demanding stakeholders, including co-founders and investors.

  • Strategic mindset: You think like a business partner, not just a finance controller, and you are comfortable challenging leadership with data-backed recommendations.

  • Operational rigor: You are structured, data-driven, and detail-oriented, with a talent for spotting flaws and building processes that prevent them.

  • AI-native mindset: You use AI tools in your work today and have a practical point of view on how they change the finance function.

  • Languages: You are fluent in English (the main language we use internally). French is a plus but not mandatory

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
description:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client.

  • Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires

  • Structurer un réseau sélectif de partenaires auprès des hôtels de luxe, palaces, spas, cliniques esthétiques, clubs privés et acteurs du luxe.

  • Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic.

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

  • Manager et accompagner les responsables opérationnels et commerciaux.

  • Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilité et d'excellence commerciale.

title: Growth Marketer (m/f/d)
description:
About Benetics AI

People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.

More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.

About the role

We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next.

What we're looking for

  • Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels.

  • High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video.

  • Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign.

  • Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social.

  • Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel.

  • Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round.

  • Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful.

  • AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters.

  • Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale.

  • Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change.

  • Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site

Experience

  • 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through.

  • Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus.

  • Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful.

Why Benetics AI

  • A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan.

  • Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work.

  • Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns.

  • Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work.

How we hire

  • Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call

  • A practical case with the team.

  • Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role

  • Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter.

title: Business Developer:in & Account Manager:in (60 - 100%)
description:
Software für Menschen.

Zeilenwerk entwickelt massgeschneiderte Business-Applikationen für die öffentliche Verwaltung und Unternehmen. Unsere Kund:innen sind wenige, dafür grosse Organisationen, die wir über Jahre begleiten. In unserer DNA verbinden sich holistisches Design, moderne Technologien und eine klare Haltung für Open Source und gegen Vendor Lock-in.

Wir sind selbstorganisiert und unabhängig: Alle tragen unternehmerische Verantwortung und entscheiden mit. Unser internes Ethics Board sorgt dafür, dass wir nur Projekte annehmen, hinter denen wir stehen können.

Unser Markt verändert sich gerade grundlegend. KI verändert, wie Software entsteht, was sie kostet und was Kund:innen von uns erwarten. Wer jetzt die richtigen Fragen stellt und mutig neue Angebote entwickelt, gestaltet diesen Wandel mit. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

  • Markt und Strategie: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Zeilenwerk marktorientiert weiter, erkennst Veränderungen in unseren Zielmärkten und übersetzt sie in neue Angebote und Positionierungen. Dazu formulierst du Experimente zu Angeboten, validierst diese und entwickelst daraus konkrete Offerings.

  • Neukundenakquise und Pipeline: Du treibst die Akquise neuer Kund:innen voran, qualifizierst Opportunities und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

  • Ausschreibungen: Du koordinierst unsere Teilnahme an öffentlichen Ausschreibungen und erarbeitest die Angebote zusammen mit einem Bidding-Team aus verschiedenen Rollen.

  • Key Account Management: Du pflegst die Beziehungen zu unseren grossen Kund:innen auf Entscheidungsebene und entwickelst sie strategisch weiter.

  • Netzwerk und Sichtbarkeit: Du pflegst Partnerschaften, vertrittst Zeilenwerk an Veranstaltungen, in Netzwerken und auf LinkedIn und prägst die Diskussion zu Digitalisierung, KI und nutzerzentrierte Software mit.

Qualifikation

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Verkauf, idealerweise von Software oder digitalen Dienstleistungen, mit nachweisbaren Abschlüssen im Bereich 100K+.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Verkaufszyklen: viele Stakeholder, lange Entscheidungswege, wenige, dafür grosse Kund:innen.

  • Strategisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, Visionen und Strategien in konkrete Massnahmen umzusetzen.

  • Unternehmerischen Antrieb, Kreativität und den Mut, Neues auszuprobieren, auch wenn der Ausgang offen ist.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Softwareprojekte funktionieren, und Neugier für die Veränderungen durch KI.

  • Von Vorteil: Idealerweise Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Erarbeitung von öffentlichen Ausschreibungen

  • Von Vorteil: ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder bei grösseren Unternehmen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift (~C1).

  • Du kannst Nein sagen und organisierst dich selbst. Erfahrung in selbstorganisierten Kontexten (Holacracy, Sociocracy etc.) ist ein Plus.

Benefits

  • 💸 Self-Set-Salary Prozess, bei dem du einen Teil deines Lohns selbst bestimmst

  • 💰 Volle Gewinnbeteiligung: Jeglicher Gewinn wird an Mitarbeitende gemäss Pensum ausgeschüttet (zusätzlich zum Basislohn, siehe Lohnspanne)

  • 😍 40-Stunden-Woche (4.5% weniger als CH-Durchschnitt)

  • 🏝️ 6 Wochen Ferien (15% mehr als CH-Durchschnitt)

  • 🚀 Nach einem Jahr kannst du (gleichbeteiligte!) Teilhaber:in von Zeilenwerk werden

  • 🕑 Deine Arbeitszeiten musst du einzig mit deinen Teamkolleg:innen absprechen

  • 🗺️ Remote-friendly: Wir sehen dich gerne ab und zu in Person, aber arbeiten kannst du innerhalb der Schweiz, wo du willst

  • 🧡 Family-friendly: Wir nehmen Rücksicht auf unsere Leben ausserhalb von Zeilenwerk

So sieht der Bewerbungsprozess bei Zeilenwerk aus:

Schritt 1: Kennenlernen-Call (~30min) mit dem Ziel, den gegenseitigen Fit zu bestimmen und allfällige «red flags» zu identifizieren (und zu lösen)
→ beidseitig die Frage: nach wie vor interessiert / Erwartungen realistisch zu erfüllen?

Schritt 2: Arbeitstag bei Zeilenwerk (~8h) mit dem Ziel, dass du das Team kennenlernst (und umgekehrt) sowie einen Tag «im Leben» von Zeilenwerk live miterlebst
→ beidseitig die Frage: nach wie vor interessiert?

Schritt 3: Angebot von Zeilenwerk an dich

Als Werkstudent bist du Teil unseres Customer-Support- und Operations-Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der direkten Kundenbetreuung, der Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen sowie der Unterstützung unseres Schweizer Teams.

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

description:

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

 

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

 

What we're looking for

  • Native French speaker;

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 

What we offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

  • Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
